--Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Lalit Miglani and Mr. Anand Bhardwaj, 
learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned Standing Counsel
for the State.
3. Mr. Vikas Pande, learned counsel for the 
Caveator, though he has not been impleaded as 
party in the present writ petition.
4. Petitioner is aggrieved by the order dated 
20.08.2026 passed by respondent no.2 and order 
dated 21.08.2026 passed by respondent no.3, 
annexure-8 & 9 to the writ petition, whereby 
petitioner was reverted to the post of Registrar 
Kanoongo from Naib Tehsildar. 
5. Petitioner claims that he should not have been 
reverted in view of the fact that petitioner is a 
physically challenged person, as he was promoted 
after giving the benefit of reservation of disability. 
Petitioner relied upon the Government Order dated 
14.06.2018 issued by the State Government, 
Personnel Department, whereby 4% of the 
sanctioned posts are reserved for persons with 
disabilities. 6. Learned counsel for the respondent/State is 
directed to get instructions in the matter as to 
whether the Government Order dated 14.06.2018 is 
still applicable and whether the reservation is still 
available in promotion for persons with disabilities, 
within three days.
7. List on 11.09.2026 as fresh.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
07.09.2026 AK
